stage0050b_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$甲児$$
「So $$アドヴェント$$ is with Geminis too!?」

stage0050b_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That bastard!
　So it was all an act in Orb, to set us up!」

stage0050b_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$シモン$$
「To the port!
　We're taking them head on!」

stage0050b_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$n
「$$ノーマン$$... I have to go.
　When I'm back, tell me more stories again...!」

stage0050b_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ダストン$$
「Colonel $$ブライト$$...!
　Don't forget, we still haven't
　fully trusted you people yet!」

stage0050b_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I'm well aware of that.
　But so long as those people, Geminis,
　keep attacking, we must fight them!」

stage0050b_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ダストン$$
（What in the world is going on...?
　First, visitors from a foreign land appear,
　and now, machines like that as well...!）

stage0050b_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$メラン$$
「Captain, we recovered the crew flung into the city,
　and confirmed $$千鳥かなめ$$ and the rest are safe」

stage0050b_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All right...!
　Launch every unit that's ready!」

stage0050b_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Damn it!
　So $$アドヴェント$$,
　they really were playing us all along!」

stage0050b_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That person... they saved $n and
　fought against Geminis, and yet...」

stage0050b_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$タケル$$
「Save that thought for later!
　First, let's crush the enemy in front of us!」

stage0050b_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$葵$$
「If we take these guys down,
　$$アドヴェント$$ might show up too, you know!」

stage0050b_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$バナージ$$
「A Neo Zeon mobile suit...!」

stage0050b_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$リディ$$
「That's not all!
　There's a Federation $$ジェガン$$ here too!」

stage0050b_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「And they're right alongside each other...
　I guess those people got sent here too...」

stage0050b_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$エマ$$
「Still, there's something odd about this.
　Every unit's in tatters, too...」

stage0050b_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$カツ$$
「Anyway, they cleared out Geminis for us.
　I don't think they're hostile to us, but...」

stage0050b_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$シモン$$
「Watch out!
　They're after us too!」

stage0050b_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$赤木$$
「What is with these guys!?
　We've got no interest in fighting!」

stage0050b_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$メラン$$
「No good!
　That machine appears to be unmanned!」

stage0050b_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$メラン$$
「Colonel $$ダストン$$ of the military police
　says he has no idea who they are either!」

stage0050b_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So we have no choice but to fight...!」

stage0050b_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, destroy the unmanned force at once!
　Keep damage to the city to a minimum!」

stage0050b_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「They're the ones who bear the $$烙印$$...
　So it really does come to this...」

stage0050b_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「These quiet days are coming to an end...
　If that's how it is, then maybe I should...」

stage0050b_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$シン$$
「Both the $$ジェガン$$ and the $$ギラ・ドーガ$$
　outperformed what our data said they could.」

stage0050b_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$刹那$$
「Just what are they, exactly...?
　Why come after us in the first place...?」

stage0050b_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「At any rate, they don't seem to be
　in league with Geminis, at least.」

stage0050b_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ブライト$$
「I don't want to provoke this city's people.
　All units, fall back immediately.」

stage0050b_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Hmm... an unexpected guest has shown up.
　Should I be glad, or troubled...?」

stage0050b_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Well... let's look on the bright side.
　Seems it marked them as intruders, at least.」

stage0050b_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Just as expected of the frozen paradise's
　guardians, those linking ruin and rebirth.
　They'll prove more useful than I thought.」

stage0050b_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
？？？
「A world engulfed in flames...
　And then, the Big...」

stage0050b_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「That's a shame.
　I never thought you'd look away from the truth.」

stage0050b_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「But this false peace is ending soon!
　The truth surfaces, and fire engulfs the world anew!!」

stage0050b_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ベック$$
「Bravo, bravo!
　Ahh... what a show!」

stage0050b_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ベック$$
「Here, this is a tip for you.
　Go on, keep it.」

stage0050b_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ベック$$
「Keep on entertaining me,
　the president of Paradigm Corp, won't you?」

stage0050b_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$桂$$
（That's what I said, but this headache...
　It's been like this ever since I got flung to this world）

stage0050b_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$葵$$
（What is this...
　Something inside me is trying to wake up...）

stage0050b_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$葵$$
（The harder I hold it back, the more it wells up...!
　This feeling... it's oddly nostalgic...!）

stage0050b_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$アマタ$$
（What is this...
　This feeling of my heart growing utterly clear...）

stage0050b_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$アマタ$$
（It's as if Aquarion and I are becoming one...
　This feeling... I wonder if $$ミコノ$$ feels it too...）

stage0050b_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$シモン$$
「My drill...!
　It calls the storm, and reaches the heavens someday!」

stage0050b_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「What's wrong, $$シモン$$?
　Why are you getting so worked up?」

stage0050b_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$シモン$$
「Like hell I need a reason...!
　I just spin my drill following my heart,
　and keep pushing forward, that's all!」

stage0050b_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What's wrong!?
　The enemy's right in front of you!」

stage0050b_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$n
（That Miss $$スズネ$$ I saw back then...
　Just what was that all about...）
